{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/trial.csv')

# Step 1: Deduplicate by keeping highest sample_seq per patient
df = df.sort_values('sample_seq', ascending=False).drop_duplicates(subset='patient_id', keep='first')

# Step 2: Exclude QC-failed baseline values (biomarker_baseline == -999)
df = df[df['biomarker_baseline'] != -999]

# Step 3: Filter for patients with SEVERE disease
severe_df = df[df['severity'] == 'severe']

# Step 4: Compute mean baseline biomarker value (ng/mL)
mean_baseline_severe = severe_df['biomarker_baseline'].mean()

# Step 5: Print the mean value only, without any extra text or formatting
print(mean_baseline_severe)"}
